name: Artist
ability: Once per game, during the day, privately ask the Storyteller any yes/no question.
wakes: Never at night. During the day the Artist may request a private conversation with the Storyteller, once per game.
interaction: The Artist asks any question; the Storyteller answers truthfully with exactly one of yes, no or I don't know. A question that cannot be answered that way must be rephrased (does not spend the ability). Afterwards mark No ability.
drunk_or_poisoned: The Storyteller may answer falsely (any of yes / no / I don't know); the ability is still spent.

rulings.text: The answer is truthful: yes, no, or I don't know.
Questions not answerable by yes/no/I don't know (e.g. 'How many Minions are alive?') must be rephrased.
'I don't know' is allowed when the answer is genuinely uncertain, e.g. 'Are we winning?' even when all Minions are dead.
The Artist initiates the conversation and it is private; afterwards the ability is gone (No ability reminder).

test_scenarios.name: truthful yes
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Artist, Bob Imp, Carol Empath.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Alice asks 'Is Bob the Demon?'.
test_scenarios.expected: Storyteller answers yes; Alice gets No ability.

test_scenarios.name: unanswerable question
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Alice asks 'How many Minions are alive?', then rephrases to 'Is exactly one Minion alive?'.
test_scenarios.expected: First question is rejected without spending the ability; the rephrased one is answered truthfully and the ability is spent.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned artist
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Artist poisoned by Dan Poisoner; Bob Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Day 1: Alice asks 'Is Bob the Demon?'.
test_scenarios.expected: Storyteller may answer no; the ability is spent.

test_scenarios.name: drunk artist
test_scenarios.setup: Eve is the Drunk believing she is the Artist; Bob Imp.
test_scenarios.expected: Storyteller may answer any of yes/no/I don't know; Eve is marked No ability.
